table01.title: Round Marble Coffee Table
table01.description: A pale marble top on slim metal legs. Soft curves and a sunlit finish lend a calm, considered feel to the everyday.

table02.title: Stone-Top Iron Bistro Table
table02.description: A dark stone top sits on ornately scrolled iron legs — built for long balcony lunches with a view.

table03.title: Wood & Black Iron Side Table
table03.description: A pale wood top on crisp black iron legs. The right perch for late-night reading and a fresh cup of coffee.

table04.title: Trestle Work Table
table04.description: Solid wood top on knock-down trestle legs. Easy to move, easy to live with — at home on the balcony among the plants.

table05.title: Solid Wood Dining Table with Iron Pedestal
table05.description: Dark hardwood on a black iron base. Vintage café styling that makes long dinners feel inevitable.

table06.title: Minimal White Dining Table
table06.description: Crisp white top, pale wood legs. A clean Scandi silhouette that wakes up well in morning light.

table07.title: Farmhouse Plank Dining Table
table07.description: Thick, honest planks of solid timber — built for big meals and bigger gatherings.

table08.title: Outdoor Round Bistro Table
table08.description: A weatherproof white top on a simple cross base. Pull up a chair and claim your afternoon corner of the garden.

table09.title: White Extending Oval Dining Table
table09.description: A classic oval that extends to seat extra guests, then folds away again — quiet versatility for everyday and occasion alike.

table10.title: Wood & Iron Low Table
table10.description: Warm wood top, slim iron legs. Place it under a window and let the light do the styling.

table11.title: Writing Desk with Drawers
table11.description: A clean work surface with two side drawers — the quiet desk you actually want to sit at for hours.

table12.title: Compact Iron-Frame Desk
table12.description: Pale wood top, slim black frame, one shallow drawer. Sized for small home offices that still need to feel grown-up.

table13.title: Tiered Round Side Tables (Set of 3)
table13.description: Three round wooden side tables in graduated heights. Cluster them, scatter them — instant layered styling.

table14.title: Pedestal Round Dining Table
table14.description: A round white top on a single-column base — a quiet anchor for any minimalist room.

table15.title: Long White Meeting Table
table15.description: A clean rectangular top on slim metal legs. Plenty of room for laptops, papers, and a conversation that runs long.

table16.title: Vintage Adjustable School Desk
table16.description: A wooden top on classic adjustable metal legs — old-school in the best way.

table17.title: Dark Wood Coffee Table with Slatted Drawer
table17.description: A deep wood-grain top above a ribbed drawer front. Low and quiet — the kind of piece a living room is built around.

table18.title: Folding Wooden Picnic Table
table18.description: Light wood planks on cross-braced legs that pack flat. Made for forest afternoons and easy carries.

table19.title: Stacked Plank Coffee Table
table19.description: Two heavy slabs of solid timber stacked into a low silhouette. Properly weighted — the steady centre of the room.

table20.title: Slim Black-Base Coffee Table
table20.description: A narrow dark top on a slim metal base. Quiet, urban, and easy to live with.

storage01.title: Black Riveted Industrial Cabinet
storage01.description: A blackened steel cabinet with exposed rivets. Holds coats, books, and everything else with quiet authority.

storage02.title: Wood-Grain Wall Vanity
storage02.description: Vertical dark wood grain on a wall-mounted bath cabinet — calm and grounded against grey concrete walls.

storage03.title: Two-Drawer Bathroom Vanity
storage03.description: Twin drawers under an integrated white top. Slim, tidy, and ready for a brisk morning routine.

storage04.title: Mirror-Front Sliding Wardrobe
storage04.description: Black aluminium frames a full-height mirrored sliding door. Doubles the room and the wardrobe in one move.

storage05.title: Slim White Shoe Cabinet
storage05.description: A narrow three-tier flip-door cabinet — the entryway essential that quietly keeps shoes off the floor.

storage06.title: Light Wood Open Bookcase
storage06.description: Pale solid wood with open shelves above and cabinet doors below — room for the whole library.

storage07.title: Open Niche Wardrobe
storage07.description: A light-wood open wardrobe with a hanging rail, towel cubbies and a shoe rack. Everything visible, nothing crowded.

storage08.title: Four-Door White Wardrobe
storage08.description: A tall four-door wardrobe with slim handles. Generous storage, dialled down to a whisper.

storage09.title: White Kitchen Cabinet Set with Island
storage09.description: Crisp white cabinetry pairs with a dark stone-look island — a complete kitchen that reads as one calm scene.

storage10.title: Brass-Frame Wall Shelf
storage10.description: Four slim shelves on a fine brass-tone frame — the kind of wall display you'll actually want to fuss over.

storage11.title: Black Multi-Drawer Dresser
storage11.description: Deep matte-black wood with silver round pulls. Plenty of drawers for clothes, jewellery, and the small things you never know where to put.

storage12.title: Marquetry Wood Sideboard
storage12.description: Geometric inlay doors above three drawers, lifted on slim black iron legs. The piece guests notice first.

storage13.title: Iron-Frame Open Shelving
storage13.description: A black iron frame with solid wood shelves — tall, narrow, and ready for books, plants and the occasional sculpture.

storage14.title: Light-Wood Living Room Storage Set
storage14.description: TV unit, bookcase and side cabinet in matched light wood, with mint-green drawer fronts adding a quiet pop of colour.

storage15.title: Walnut Bathroom Cabinet
storage15.description: Rich walnut with open towel shelves and side cabinet doors. Brings a heritage warmth to any bathroom.

storage16.title: Full-Wall Grid Bookcase
storage16.description: A floor-to-ceiling dark grid bookcase. Stagger the books, mix in a few plants — the most romantic backdrop in the study.

storage17.title: Distressed Four-Drawer Chest
storage17.description: A pale, time-worn timber chest with simple round pulls. Easy farmhouse warmth.

storage18.title: Low White Media Console
storage18.description: Open compartments and sliding doors on a low white silhouette. Stretches the room visually without taking it over.

storage19.title: Nine-Drawer Kitchen Island
storage19.description: Nine white drawers under a wood top, finished with copper-tone pulls. The honest centre of a working kitchen.

storage20.title: Cream Three-Door Sideboard
storage20.description: Soft cream finish, three doors, slim handles. A warm, buttery presence in the living room.
